paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Estimator role in Murray Bridge advertised on SEEK. Your advert says estimating experience is a bonus and that people keen to move into estimating are welcome, and that is exactly where I am. A civil contractor working on earthworks, roads, drainage and subdivisions is the kind of business I want to learn with.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and my coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities. That estimating work is from study, not a paid estimating role.

Before moving to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and kept site reports, material records and progress reports, and as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I reviewed drawings and coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am currently in Melton, Victoria, and I am open to discussing relocation to Murray Bridge for the right role.
I would welcome a conversation about the role. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
